rerecord_tips_en: Record in bright light and use slow-motion mode to reduce motion blur
Tape the ruler flat on the wall directly behind the ball fall path so ruler and ball are the same distance from the camera
Hold the ball steady beside the ruler, then release gently without pushing and move the hand out of view
Keep the phone still on a support with the ruler and full fall visible from release to floor impact
Track coverage is 71%: the object was not found in some frames, usually from motion blur. Use slow motion or more light.

Ruler scale (0.415 mm/px) and ball-diameter scale (0.668 mm/px) disagree by 61.1%. The ruler is probably closer to or farther from the camera than the ball's path. Tape the ruler to the wall directly behind the falling ball.
The fit explains the track poorly (R² 0.9975, RMS 5.02 px). The fit window may include contact or hands.
rerecord_tips_id: Rekam di cahaya terang dan gunakan mode gerak lambat agar bola tidak buram
Tempel penggaris tegak di dinding tepat di belakang jalur jatuh bola agar jarak ke kamera sama
Pegang bola dengan tenang di samping penggaris lalu lepaskan perlahan tanpa didorong dan jauhkan tangan dari kamera
Diamkan ponsel di atas penyangga dengan penggaris dan seluruh jatuhan terlihat dari lepas sampai lantai
Cakupan lintasan 71%: objek tidak terdeteksi di sebagian frame, biasanya karena blur gerak. Gunakan slow motion atau tambah cahaya.

Skala penggaris (0.415 mm/px) dan skala diameter bola (0.668 mm/px) berbeda 61.1%. Penggaris kemungkinan tidak sejajar dengan lintasan bola. Tempel penggaris di dinding tepat di belakang lintasan bola.
Fit menjelaskan lintasan dengan buruk (R² 0.9975, RMS 5.02 px). Jendela fit mungkin memuat kontak atau tangan.
